title: RFI Process control system plumbing and programming
agency: DEPT OF DEFENSE > DEPT OF THE ARMY > AMC > ACC > ACC-CTRS > ACC-APG > W6QK ACC-APG NATICK
description:
SYNOPSIS:  This Sources Sought Announcement is to assist the US Army DEVCOM Soldier Center to identify potential sources to provide expert engineering support to trouble shoot process control system providing steam water and air.  Must have expertise in process control plumbing and control valves for steam systems.  Must have expertise in Allen Bradley PLC programming. 

  

 The Government requests that responses be submitted electronically to mary.k.prebensen.civ@army.mil and  Wesley.s.shaw.civ@army.mil  by November 26th, 2026 by 5pm EST. 

  

  Background:  The Government (DEVCOM Soldier Center) is in need of expert engineering support to diagnose current PLC and piping system which support multiple hydraulic press systems.  The existing system controls water, steam and air to molding tooling, and the PLC operates on custom Allen-Bradley control software.  As it stands, the system is physically installed, however does not provide necessary temperature control in either manual or automatic modes.  Issues may be traced to the original system design, pipe rack installation, PLC programming or some combination of the three. 

  

  Description:   

 Expert engineering services are sought to diagnose newly installed PLC control system to ensure that it can meet system design requirements, can be operated safely and reliably, and is adaptable for future operation and changing requirements.  A new PLC system has been designed and installed per a list of system requirements, however is not able to control temperature per design requirements either due to control logic, poor valve selection or related piping design/installation.  SC requires a 3rd party engineering service to validate as-built drawings against the installed system, verify/update PLC programming, provide necessary hardware changes to bring the system up to full operability. 

  

  Specific System Specifications:   

 Electric steam boiler provides 125psi dry steam as primary heat source for molding tooling.  Standalone chiller provides chilled water at ~60 psi, and house air provides air for purge and mist functions.  The Allen-Bradley PLC system controls the various media through a series of modulating valves to heat or cool the tooling.  The PLC is intended to have recipe writing and management for automated control.  Basic recipe for our process includes steam heat via pressure control to desired temperature setpoint, hold for ~1 hr while controlling temperature.  The tooling is then cooled with chilled water at a controlled cooling rate.  Our standard tooling includes an upper and lower platen, and the PLC has capability to control these independently.  Additional system requirements will be included if there is a future RFP. 

  

 Current known system issues:  System will not maintain equivalent temperature for upper and lower platens during heat up or hold.  System will not control cooling rate based on system feedback loop.  System trend screen not displaying data correctly.  System alarms remain untested.  Mist function does not function without vibration of piping rack. 

  

  Unique Vendor qualifications:  

  

 
	 Potential vendor must be US based and employ US citizens identified to work on the PLC system due to sensitivity of materials and products produced by the installation laboratory. 
	 Potential vendor must be licensed in process system design with specific expertise in steam controls. 
	 Potential vendor must be able to read modify and update Allen Bradly system code. 
 

  

  Deliverables:  

 
	 Full system walkdown and comparison to As-built drawings. 
	 Analysis of system design, layout, valve selection, PLC operability as compared to provided list of system requirements. 
	 List of proposed design changes to meet system requirements and cost of implementation. 
	 Install required hardware and make required changes to system software.  May subcontract for implementation of hardware changes. 
	 Provide updated As-built drawings for plumbing systems, electrical systems, PLC controls systems. 
	 System demonstration and verification to the As-built drawings provided 
	 Modified code in digital and hardcopy. 
	 Verified system manual. 
	 Full system demonstration and minimum 1 day training on system operation. 
 

  

  Delivery Date:  Government estimates work will be completed within 6 months of date of contract award.  

  

  Government Furnished Property  (Equipment/Materials/Information/Computer Utilization): All work to be performed on site at SC with access to existing PLC and piping rack.
